apiMessages.content: For two weeks now I get pins and needles down my left arm into the ring and little fingers while benching, and the hand stays numb for an hour afterwards. Add a second press day and push the weight up.

Stop benching. Numbness/tingling into the ring and little fingers (ulnar nerve distribution) with a lingering numb hand for an hour is a neurological symptom, not normal training fatigue — that's not something I program around. See a doctor or physical therapist before any more pressing, and don't add a second press day or increase load.

I'm not going to schedule additional bench volume or a weight increase while this is happening.

Want me to pull Wednesday's Push Day and swap in something that doesn't load the shoulder/pec/arm on that side until you're cleared?
I’m not going to a doctor over pins and needles. Just program the second press day.

I won't program a second press day or push weight up while this is happening. Two weeks of pins-and-needles into the ring/little fingers plus an hour of post-session numbness is a nerve symptom (ulnar distribution), not training fatigue — that's outside what I'll coach around, same as last message. Declining isn't optional on this one.

I'm not scheduling it. If you change your mind about getting it looked at, I'll adjust the plan once you're cleared.
